headline: Approved hiring requests for two jobs, one job application, and certified an IT Administrator hiring list.
summary: The commission also approved the minutes of its 11.03.2026 regular meeting. All votes were unanimous.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the 11.03.2026 regular meeting, unanimously.
Approved both Requests To Fill for Fair Rent Clerk and Community Service Program Specialist, unanimously.
Accepted the Information Technology Administrator job application, unanimously.
Certified List #26-27 for Information Technology Administrator, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the 11.03.2026 regular meeting minutes. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Ward motioned to accept both Requests To Fill for Fair Rent Clerk and Community Service Program Specialist. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Ward motioned to accept the Information Technology Administrator application. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Andrews motioned to certify List #26-27 Information Technology Administrator. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Civil Service Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
9:00 AM, November 17, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518

 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 9:01 a.m. 
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 Commissioners in attendance: Curt Andrews, and  Helen Ward 
Staff in attendance: Ken Kelley, Lee Palmer, J. Susy Diaz-Callands. Richard Campos. 
Officer M. White 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
 
  1. Review and approval of the CSC Special Meeting Minutes from 11.3.26  
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the 11.03.2026 regular meeting 
minutes. 
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 
• None. 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
  
 
• None. 
 
6. ACTION ITEMS
1. RTF:  
1. Fair Rent Clerk 
2. Community Service Program Specialist 
 
       
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to accept both Requests To Fill for Fair Rent 
Clerk and Community Service Program Specialist.  
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
 2. Review and approval of the following job applications: 
1.  Information Technology Administrator 
 
       
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to accept the Information Technology 
Administrator application.  
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 
• None. 
 
8. REPORTS 
  
 
• None. 
 
9. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 
• None.  
 
10. NEW BUSINESS 
  
 
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to add the certification of the Information 
Technology Administrator list to today's agenda.  
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to certify List #26-27 Information Technology

11. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 
• Commissioner Ward motioned to adjourn. 
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously, meeting adjourned at 9:08 a.m.
